name: Simetría de Orejas
description: Compara la simetría de las orejas para detectar inconsistencias de deepfake
algorithm: Ear Symmetry Analysis — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes bilateral ear symmetry for deepfake detection:

1. **Bilateral Ear Detección**: Both ears are detected when visible. Their geometric landmarks — helix attachment point, lobule tip, tragion, ear length, ear width, protrusion angle — are measured per frame.

2. **Simetría Análisis**: Natural ears exhibit consistent but imperfect bilateral symmetry (minor asymmetry is normal). The method quantifies symmetry metrics: size ratio, shape similarity (procrustes distance), and protrusion angle difference. Deepfakes may produce: (a) perfectly symmetric ears (too artificial), (b) grossly asymmetric ears (generator inconsistency), or (c) ears symmetric in ways inconsistent with natural anatomical variation.

3. **Head Pose - Corrected Comparación**: Apparent ear asymmetry changes with head pose — the closer ear appears larger due to perspective. The method corrects for head pose using estimated 3D head orientation, comparing ears in a pose-normalized framework. Deepfakes may show incorrect perspective scaling of ears.

4. **Temporal Simetría Estabilidad**: The ratio and shape relationship between ears should remain constant across frames (bone/cartilage doesn't change shape). The method tracks bilateral symmetry metrics over time — temporal variation in ear symmetry indicates generation artifacts where the two ears are rendered independently per frame.

5. **Simetría Anomalía Puntuación**: The combined assessment of static symmetry plausibility, pose-corrected comparison, and temporal stability generates a forensic score. Methods like FaceForensics++ have shown that peripheral face regions (ears, hairline) carry important manipulation cues often overlooked by face-centric generators.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante ear symmetry analysis analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
